# Known flaky tests of upstream (SYNC.md, "Known flaky tests"): tests seen failing by chance
# on unchanged main, whatever the cause (a clock, a race, an order, a slow result). When one
# fails on the candidate (first run or package rerun), check.sh retries it alone, in a fresh
# go test process, until it passes, at most <retries> times; the verdict waives it only when
# a retry passed. A test that fails every retry still fails the check.
#
# <package> <test> <date added> <retries> <failed>/<runs> <cause>
#   <failed>/<runs>: the rate the retries are sized to: the test alone, as the retries run
#   it, or, when it never failed alone, where it was seen failing (SYNC.md says which).
#   <retries>: the smallest n, at least 2, with (failed/runs)^n under 1/1000 (check.sh
#   refuses any other count). <cause>: the other rates seen, and why it fails, in a few words.
